name: Stonetalon Peak
summary: At Stonetalon Peak, kaldorei Sentinels and druids keep watch over an ancient sanctuary. The sheltered valley is sacred to the night elves and remains the Alliance’s main foothold in the high mountains.

sections.title: A Sacred Mountain Vale
sections.body: Stonetalon Peak opens into a green valley high above the dry lower ranges. Its ruins reach back millennia, to temples that honored Queen Azshara before the Great Sundering. Night elven Sentinels and druids now care for the sanctuary. They keep a barrow den and an Alliance flight roost here.

sections.title: Crossroads of Destiny
sections.body: During the Third War, Jaina Proudmoore’s human expedition and Thrall’s Horde climbed Stonetalon Peak, each seeking the Oracle in the mountain’s deep caverns. Medivh’s visions had guided them there. Their encounter brought mortal enemies together, and they set aside their blades. That uneasy pact helped them stand against the Burning Legion at Mount Hyjal. Sentinel patrols still guard the peak, while Horde incursions in the lowlands keep its defenders alert.

faq.q: Why is Stonetalon Peak so green compared to the rest of the mountains?
faq.answer: A sheltered basin and ancient magic help keep Stonetalon Peak green. Night elves and druids from nearby Talon Den care for its forest, which contrasts with the charred, jagged cliffs below.

faq.q: What happened here during the Third War?
aliases: what happened at stonetalon peak warcraft 3
faq.answer: During the Third War, Jaina Proudmoore and Thrall came to Stonetalon Peak seeking the Oracle in the mountain caverns, guided by Medivh’s warnings. Their meeting led humans and orcs to make a truce against the Burning Legion.

faq.q: Who controls Stonetalon Peak right now?
aliases: is stonetalon peak alliance or horde
faq.answer: The Alliance holds Stonetalon Peak, where night elf Sentinels and druids maintain the outpost. It offers Alliance travelers a haven, flight connections, and aid in the Stonetalon Mountains.

faq.q: What ancient ruins are located here?
faq.answer: The vale’s crumbling pillars and marble buildings are remnants of the ancient night elven empire. They once formed temple grounds dedicated to Queen Azshara, before her descent into madness and the Great Sundering.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler, you can find shelter, flight paths, and aid at Stonetalon Peak, your fortified foothold in the western mountains.
As a druid, you can look to Stonetalon Peak and the sacred Talon Den as places tied to Cenarion history, pilgrimage, and the defense of the wild.
